channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Dr Dzul honours organ donor Muhammad Zahran in heartfelt tribute
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Health Minister Datuk Seri Dr Dzulkefly Ahmad paid tribute to late Muhammad Zahran Mohd Zuraidi, who donated his organs to save lives after passing away at Hospital Selayang this morning.

item.title: Eight-year-old boy drowns in river on first visit
item.description: SIK: An eight-year-old boy drowned in Sungai Muda at Kampung Tanjung Jeneri near Sik today.

item.title: LLM reports heavy traffic on city-bound routes
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Traffic on several major highways in the country began to build tonight as people returned to the capital after the Aidilfitri holidays.

item.title: Firefighters, police search for elderly man, grandson missing in Keningau river
item.description: KENINGAU: An elderly man and his seven-year-old grandson were reported missing in a river near Taman Bersatu here today.

item.title: Petrol dealers urge govt cooperation to ease RON95 liability
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Petroleum Dealers Association of Malaysia (PDAM) has called for stronger strategic cooperation between the government and petrol station operators to reduce liability burdens on station owners.

item.title: France turns attention to 2027 presidential race
item.description: WITH local elections done and dusted, France is pivoting towards electing a president to replace Emmanuel Macron next year, with the far right scenting its best chance yet to seize power.

item.title: Trump names tech titans to science advisory council
item.description: WASHINGTON: President Donald Trump on Wednesday named some of the biggest names in US technology to his Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, assembling a roster that includes Meta founder Mark Zuckerberg and Google co-founder Sergey Brin.

item.title: Seremban riders rush woman through Raya traffic to hospital for childbirth [WATCH]
item.description: SEREMBAN: A man received a remarkable act of kindness from six motorcyclists while rushing his wife to Hospital Tuanku Jaafar (HTJ) in Seremban for childbirth on the third night of Hari Raya.

item.title: Liverpool great Toshack has dementia, says son
item.description: LONDON: Liverpool and Wales great John Toshack, who managed Real Madrid and his national team, has been diagnosed with dementia, according to his son Cameron.

item.title: ETS and KTM Komuter between Batu Caves and Pulau Sebang disrupted
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Keretapi Tanah Melayu Berhad (KTMB) has announced disruptions on its electric train service (ETS) and KTM Komuter after an overhead line fault at KM 434.42 between Batang Benar and Labu stations.

item.title: Luxury Paris hotel near Elysee reopens after fire forces brief closure
item.description: PARIS: A five-star hotel near the Elysee presidential palace in Paris reopened on Wednesday after a blaze earlier forced around 400 people to evacuate the building, the French capital's firefighters and the hotel said.

item.title: Man detained over Facebook post insulting Prophet Muhammad
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Police detained a 47-year-old local man suspected of insulting Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) over a Facebook post that recently went viral.

item.title: Ex-junior hockey captain builds RM40mil business empire
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Starting with a business capital of just RM30, he now possesses business assets worth approximately RM40 million.

item.title: Melaka police detain mother, four others over baby skeleton discovery
item.description: MELAKA: A 19-year-old woman is among five individuals detained so far to assist in the investigation into the discovery of a baby’s skeleton at a house compound in Kelemak, Alor Gajah, today.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Fyna Jebat vents frustration, heads to court: 'I've been hidden for four years'
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Singer Fyna Jebat has voiced her deep frustration and disappointment after alleging that she was "kept hidden" for four years by an individual whose identity remains undisclosed.
